---
title: "Analyze Biological Function Categorization"
subtitle: "Top `r params$top_n` condition-specific GO terms"
params:
  top_n: 1000
---

## Overview

Visualizes the distribution of automated biological function categories across dementia transition conditions for the top `r params$top_n` condition-specific GO terms. Since the reviewer round (2026-10-09) each term counts by its specificity weight w (`06_go_hierarchy/03_go_term_weights.qmd`): a category's count in a group is the sum of its terms' weights, rounded half up, and the bar heights use these rounded counts so that they agree with the labels.

## Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false

pacman::p_load(readxl, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)

source(here("custom_func/go_term_weights.R"))
```

## Load the data

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false

function_categorization <- read_excel(
  here(glue("pathway_analysis/04_function_categorization/output/top{params$top_n}_condition_specific_GO_terms_auto_cat.xlsx"))
) |>
  filter(!is.na(function_category)) |>
  mutate(condition = fct_relevel(condition, "normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev"))

glue("Loaded {nrow(function_categorization)} categorized GO terms (NA categories removed)")
```

### Join the specificity weights

Every categorized term must have a weight. The weights' `condition` is given the same factor levels first, because a join of a factor with a character key returns a character column and the facets would fall back to alphabetical order.

```{r}
#| label: join-weights

function_categorization <- function_categorization |>
  left_join(
    read_go_term_weights(params$top_n) |>
      select(condition, ID, w) |>
      mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = levels(function_categorization$condition))),
    by = c("condition", "ID")
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(function_categorization$w),
  is.factor(function_categorization$condition)
)
```

## Barplot of the number of terms in function categories

### Count the number of terms in each function category

```{r}
#| label: count-biofunc

function_categorization_count <- function_categorization |>
  summarise(sum_w = sum(w, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(condition, function_category)) |>
  mutate(n = round_half_up(sum_w)) |>
  group_by(function_category) |>
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### Order function_category by percentage

```{r}
#| label: order-biofunc

function_categorization_ordered <-
  function_categorization_count |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(function_category, condition, percentage, n) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = c(percentage, n)) |>
  arrange(desc(percentage_normal2mci), desc(percentage_stable_mci), desc(percentage_normal2incid), desc(percentage_mci2incid), desc(percentage_prev), desc(n_normal2mci), desc(n_stable_mci), desc(n_normal2incid), desc(n_mci2incid), desc(n_prev)) |>
  pull(function_category)
```

### Assign the ordered function_category

```{r}
#| label: assign-ordered-biofunc

function_categorization_count_ordered <- function_categorization_count |>
  mutate(function_category = factor(function_category, levels = rev(function_categorization_ordered)))
```

### All function categories

```{r}
#| label: barplot-all
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

function_categorization_count_ordered |>
  ggplot(aes(x = percentage, y = function_category)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.2, size = 8 / .pt) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18)), labels = scales::percent) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x")
```

### Function categories with a weighted count above one

```{r}
#| label: barplot-gt1
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

barplot_function_category <- function_categorization_count_ordered |>
  filter(n > 1) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = percentage, y = function_category)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.2, size = 8 / .pt) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18)), labels = scales::percent) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x")

barplot_function_category
```

## Save the plots

```{r}
#| label: save-plots

fs::dir_create(here("pathway_analysis/04_function_categorization/output"))
write_rds(barplot_function_category, here(glue("pathway_analysis/04_function_categorization/output/top{params$top_n}_barplot_function_category.rds")))
```
